topics.summary: Global climate talks failed to reach a deal on fossil fuels and funding, hindering efforts against climate change.
European middle powers are increasingly mobilizing independently, signaling a shift in global alliances without US leadership.
Libya suspects a drone attack hit a Russian ship in Benghazi, raising regional tensions and security concerns.
An automated system failure at the FAA delayed all Delta flights through Atlanta, causing significant travel disruption.
Carlos Alcaraz won the ATP Finals, securing a major title in professional tennis.
The new 'Hunger Games' film debuted with $120 million, successfully reigniting the popular franchise at the box office.

idiom.title: The early bird gets the worm
idiom.interpretationEn: This proverb originates from the feeding habits of birds. Birds that wake up early are able to find food first. Therefore, this saying is used to imply that those who start early will have success or advantages, often used to encourage people to take action early and seize opportunities.
idiom.interpretationZh: 这个谚语源自鸟类的早晨觅食习惯。早上早起的鸟儿会最先找到食物。因此，这句话用来比喻早早行动的人会获得成功或利益，常用来鼓励人们抓住机会，早些开始行动。

examples.en: She always arrives at the office before anyone else; the early bird gets the worm.
examples.zh: 她总是在其他人之前到达办公室，早起的鸟儿有虫吃。

examples.en: If you want the best deals, remember that the early bird gets the worm.
examples.zh: 如果你想要最好的交易，记得早起的鸟儿有虫吃。

examples.en: The early bird gets the worm, so I try to wake up at 5 AM every day.
examples.zh: 早起的鸟儿有虫吃，所以我每天都试图五点起床。

people.name: Eugene Stoner
people.extract: Eugene Morrison Stoner was an American machinist and firearms designer who is most associated with the development of the ArmaLite AR-15 rifle that was redesigned and modified by Colt's Patent Firearm Company for the United States military as the M16A1 rifle.
highlights: Associated with development of ArmaLite AR-15 rifle.
AR-15 redesigned as M16A1 rifle for US military.

people.name: Scarlett Johansson
people.extract: Scarlett Ingrid Johansson is an American actress, singer, producer, and director. Her films as a leading actress have grossed over $15.4 billion worldwide, making her the third-highest-grossing actor in history. Her accolades include a British Academy Film Award and a Tony Award, as well as nominations for two Academy Awards and five Golden Globe Awards. She was the world's highest-paid actress in 2018, 2019, and 2025.
highlights: American actress, singer, producer, and director.
Won British Academy Film Award and Tony Award.

people.name: Steven Van Zandt
people.extract: Steven Van Zandt, also known as Little Steven or Miami Steve, is an American musician and actor. He is a member of Bruce Springsteen's E Street Band, in which he plays guitar and mandolin. He has appeared in several television drama series, including as Silvio Dante in The Sopranos (1999–2007) and as Frank Tagliano/Giovanni "Johnny" Henriksen in Lilyhammer (2012–2014). Van Zandt has his own solo band called Little Steven and the Disciples of Soul, intermittently active since the 1980s.
highlights: Musician and actor, also known as Little Steven.
Member of Bruce Springsteen's E Street Band.
Played Silvio Dante in The Sopranos.
